subject: Senior sponsor prioritization and commitment checklist
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@retailco.com>, Aaron Mills <aaron.mills@retailco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Senior sponsor prioritization and commitment checklist

Dana / Aaron — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from the sponsor-level conversation so we all have alignment and clear next steps (short bullets). I’ve attached the pilot scope workbook for reference.

Pain points we heard (sponsor):
- Real-time personalization latency at scale: 95th percentile spikes during promotions (~750ms target vs current 1.6s).
- Unit cost for inference during peak windows is eroding margins (estimated $0.12/token equivalent today).
- Data governance: must keep PII in-region and ensure audit trails for model inputs/outputs.

Business goals (Q3 pilot → Q4 scale):
- Cut tail latency to <=350ms 95th for catalog personalization on catalog pages.
- Reduce per-request inference cost by ~30% using batching/caching and a dedicated quantized model path.
- Validate private deployment option for sensitive shopping flows.

Procurement / commitment path (what sponsor asked):
1) Pilot agreement (30–60 day) with defined success metrics and pilot credit — aim to finalize SOW and pricing by end of June.
2) Procurement review (security/compliance packet + SOC2 evidence) to happen week of 6/22.
3) Executive approval (legal & finance sign-off) targeted early July for a Q3 pilot start.

Open risks / escalation items for your leadership visibility:
- SOC2 evidence: we can provide recent certs and an audit summary, but RetailCo requires encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys for some flows (we flagged this for Private deployment scope).
- SLA exception request: sponsor asked for a 99.9% availability SLA for pilot endpoints in-region. That requires a Dedicated commitment or an explicit fall-back plan.
- Procurement cadence: RetailCo indicated multi-stakeholder procurement with a single PO may take 4–6 weeks after SOW acceptance.

Immediate asks / next steps (action owners):
- RetailCo: confirm procurement contact and any mandatory contract terms (Aaron) — target by 6/8.
- Redwood: share SOC2 package and a brief on our Private deployment options (Karthik) — shared by 6/7.
- Redwood: send a 1-page pilot success metrics & proposed SOW draft (Soojin/Marissa) — shared by 6/10.

Attachments: pilot-scope.xlsx (pilot metrics & data access requirements).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar hold for a procurement checkpoint once we have the contact.

—
Soojin Lee
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@retailco.com>

Cc: Aaron Mills <aaron.mills@retailco.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 16:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Senior sponsor prioritization and commitment checklist

Thanks, Soojin — very clear and helpful. Quick confirmations from my side:
- Procurement contact: procurement@retailco.com (I’ll loop them in after I confirm internal budget holder).
- Timeline: sponsor wants a pilot started in July if we can lock SOW + credits by end of June. That’s aggressive but doable.
- SOC2: please send the SOC2 report plus an executive summary; our security team will want to know about KMS/HSM options and whether audit logs can be exported to our Splunk instance.

Two clarifying questions:
1) For the in-region private deployment, can you outline what additional lead time (ops and infra) is required vs hosted?
2) Can you include a short failure/fallback plan if the dedicated endpoints breach latency during promotions (example: graceful degrade to cached model)?

I’ll await the SOW and SOC2 package. CC’ing Aaron for procurement context.

Best —
Dana Ortiz
VP, Digital Experience | RetailCo
dana.ortiz@retailco.com | +1 (212) 555-9876

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@retailco.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aaron Mills <aaron.mills@retailco.com>, procurement@retailco.com
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Senior sponsor prioritization and commitment checklist

Dana — good questions. Short answers and attachments below.

1) Lead time for Private (in-region) vs Hosted:
- Hosted (managed, Redwood API): pilot can start within 2–3 weeks once SOW signed and test data access is sorted.
- Private (VPC/on-prem variant): estimated 6–8 weeks for provisioning, network peering, KMS integration and operational runbooks. We can accelerate to 4–5 weeks with a committed infra slot (requires reserved capacity purchase).

2) Failure/fallback plan:
- Continuous prefix caching + a lightweight cached model for cold starts (plan included in pilot-scope).
- Canary routing: traffic routed to a smaller-capacity quantized model during promo spikes with automatic fall-back to cached responses for non-critical calls.
- Instrumentation: we’ll provide token-level latency breakdowns and an automated alerting threshold you can tune (we can push alerts to your Splunk).

Attachments included: pricing-term-sheet-v2.pdf (pilot pricing options and reserved capacity tiers), SOW-draft.pdf (outline for pilot acceptance criteria).

Proposed immediate timeline:
- 6/7: Redwood sends SOC2 package & pilot SOW draft (we’ll share the SOW and pricing PDFs today).
- 6/10: RetailCo confirms procurement contact and any mandatory legal terms.
- 6/18: Target date for procurement review meeting.
- Early July: Exec approval goal to begin pilot mid-July.

DocuSign link for a quick pilot MOU (optional, not full contract): https://www.docusign.com/s/RetailCo-Pilot-MOU

If you want, we can schedule a 20–30 minute security deep dive next week with our security lead to walk through KMS/HSM and logging.

—
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
